items.text: If you are confused about your career after graduation, the way out is a short sequence: list what you can already do, gather live evidence on three options, test the best two with a small piece of work and then choose a first move you can reverse.
Choose a first role or skill that teaches you quickly and keeps doors open.
Check official pages and live notices for every option you consider.
